about.title: About Al Nageh
about.heading: Execution experience. Schedule discipline. Lasting quality.
about.text: Al Nageh is a Kuwait-based contracting and construction company with more than 40 years of experience delivering government, commercial, healthcare, high-rise, and special construction projects to approved standards and schedules.

aboutPage.heroTitle: More Than 40 Years Delivering Major Projects
aboutPage.heroSubtitle: A Kuwait-based contracting and construction company with a proven record across Kuwait and Saudi Arabia.
aboutPage.storyTitle: Delivering with Quality, Commitment, and Precision
aboutPage.storyText1: For more than 40 years, we have been shaping the way people live, work and connect. With a commitment to excellence and a vision for the future, we continue to build trust, create value, and deliver landmarks that stand the test of time.
aboutPage.storyText2: We work closely with clients, consultants, and partners to deliver integrated solutions with high quality, precision in execution, and full commitment to schedules and standards.

founded.label: Founded in Kuwait
founded.text: Nearly 40 years ago, laying the foundation for a long track record in construction and building.

ksa.label: Expansion into Saudi Arabia
ksa.text: More than 3 years of operations delivering projects in the Kingdom.

khobar.label: The Avenues Khobar
khobar.text: Our latest and largest project to date, currently underway in Al Khobar.

today.label: Today & Beyond
today.text: Continuing to grow our presence across Kuwait and Saudi Arabia, one landmark at a time.

aboutPage.visionText: To be a trusted and leading construction company, recognized for delivering high-quality projects, professional excellence, and sustainable value across the region.
aboutPage.missionText: To deliver reliable, high-quality construction solutions through expertise, commitment, and attention to detail, building lasting partnerships while maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, efficiency, and integrity.

careers.title: Build your career
careers.subtitle: We are a contracting firm specialised in construction and finishing works, operating through two branches — Kuwait and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. If you are a skilled tradesperson or an engineer, we would like to hear from you.

why.title: Work on projects that shape the skyline.

landmark.title: Landmark projects
landmark.text: Join crews that have executed works on towers above 300 metres, large retail developments, hospitals and government facilities.

crews.title: Specialised crews
crews.text: Formwork carpenters, steel fixers and concrete crews with field experience on high-rise projects and mass pours.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.text: A safe environment for crews and site, applying safety requirements across formwork, scaffolding and lifting.

branches.title: Two branches
branches.text: We operate through two branches, Kuwait and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, so skilled people can work wherever the project is.

servicesPage.heroSubtitle: Integrated construction solutions that bring together engineering expertise, precise execution, and disciplined project management.
servicesPage.introTitle: Your partner for turning plans into lasting places
servicesPage.introText: Our expertise extends across more than one project type. We manage and deliver civil, structural, finishing, and electromechanical work packages as one coordinated system, working closely with clients, consultants, and delivery teams.
servicesPage.scopeText: A clear scope helps clients and consultants understand our role as an execution partner and integrated contractor.

reinforcedConcrete.title: Reinforced Concrete Structures
reinforcedConcrete.text: Execution of concrete structures for towers and multi-storey buildings, including rafts, columns, shear walls, slabs, and beams.

formwork.title: Formwork & Scaffolding
formwork.text: Erection and operation of formwork, scaffolding, and shoring systems for towers and structures with full safety compliance.

rebar.title: Rebar & Steel Fixing
rebar.text: Cutting, bending, and fixing reinforcement, pre-assembled cages, and dense mat reinforcement for rafts, walls, and cores.

massPours.title: Concrete Placing & Mass Pours
massPours.text: Planning and execution of continuous concrete pours, including heat-of-hydration control and curing.

excavation.title: Excavation, Shoring & Dewatering
excavation.text: Deep excavation, shoring, retaining-wall systems, and groundwater dewatering for multi-level basements.

finishes.title: Finishing Works
finishes.text: Blockwork, waterproofing and thermal insulation, plastering, painting, flooring, internal finishes, and external works.

electromechanical.title: Electromechanical Works
electromechanical.text: Coordination and delivery of electrical, mechanical, and building service systems through construction and handover.

projectManagement.title: Project Management & Delivery
projectManagement.text: Managing scope, programme, resources, and coordination between delivery teams and consultants through handover.

quality.title: Engineering quality
quality.text: Precise standards from planning to delivery.

innovation.title: Integrated vision
innovation.text: Modern solutions for every project type.

experience.title: Years of experience
experience.text: A proven record of successful projects.

safety.title: Safety & Quality
safety.subtitle: No schedule is worth an accident, and no saving is worth a structural defect.

siteSafetyPlan.title: Site Safety Plan
siteSafetyPlan.text: A written plan for every site covering excavation, lifting, and work at height, with a daily briefing before work starts.

ppe.title: Personal Protective Equipment
ppe.text: Full provision of and compliance with PPE for all workers, monitored continuously on site.

formworkInspection.title: Formwork & Scaffold Inspection
formworkInspection.text: Formwork, scaffolding, and shoring inspected and signed off before every pour — no permit to pour without it.

testing.title: Material & Concrete Testing
testing.text: Slump tests, concrete cubes, and rebar certificates kept in a documented record handed over with the project.

inspectionSignOff.title: Inspection & Sign-Off
inspectionSignOff.text: Joint inspection with the consultant for every item before it is covered, with snags cleared before moving on.

reporting.title: Periodic Reporting
reporting.text: A weekly report on progress, executed quantities, and constraints, plus a monthly technical and financial report.
